Do I Need Kubernetes for My SaaS? The Honest Answer

Quick thread 🧵
For a new or small SaaS, you almost certainly don't need Kubernetes.
It orchestrates many containers across many machines, which is a problem you get much later.
A single managed server, or a few behind a load balancer, runs a lot of real traffic.
Reach for Kubernetes when the pain is concrete, not preemptively.
